app.name: DevPilot AI
app.tagline: From a task in plain language to a specification ready to implement.
app.crashed: Something went wrong in the app. We have been notified; reload the page to carry on.

activity.chartEmpty: Bar chart: no generations from {{from}} to {{to}}.

auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.

login.title: From a task in plain language to a specification ready to implement.
login.description: Describe a feature or a bug. The AI returns a specification with six sections that you can edit and export.

register.title: Three steps between the idea and the first commit.

project.title: Create a project
project.description: State its stack and its conventions. The AI uses them as context.

describe.title: Describe the task or the bug
describe.description: In plain language, between 20 and 4,000 characters.

export.title: Edit and export the specification
export.description: Adjust the result and take it away as Markdown or JSON.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: The stack and the conventions of each project are sent to the AI as context.

empty.title: You have no projects yet
empty.description: Create the first one to give the AI context and generate your first specification.

notFound.title: We could not find this project
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or the address may be wrong.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteDialog.generations_other: Its {{count}} generations will be deleted too.

fields.name: Name
fields.techStackHint: Type a technology and press Enter to add it as a tag.
fields.conventionsHint: Free text: architecture, naming, libraries, testing criteria.

help.title: How this context is used
help.sent: Every generation sends the AI the name, the description, the stack and the conventions of the project.
help.tasks: The frontend and backend tasks in the specification mention the stack you declare here.
help.secrets: Do not include credentials, proprietary code or confidential data.

history.title: Generation history
history.outOfRange: There is nothing on this page.

empty.title: This project has no generations yet
empty.description: When you generate a specification for this project, it will appear here.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
deleteDialog.body: This generation and its specification will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

translation.failed: The specification could not be translated: {{reason}} It is shown in the language it was generated in.

placeholder.feature: Describe the feature: what it should do, for whom and why.
placeholder.bug: Describe the bug: what happens, what should happen and how to reproduce it.

form.additionalContextHint: Optional: constraints, affected screens, links to tickets…
form.quota: You have reached your limit of {{limit}} generations per day. You can generate again from {{time}}.
form.globalQuota: The service has reached its generation limit for today. Try again from {{time}}.

help.title: Before sending
help.context: The AI receives the stack and conventions of "{{project}}" along with your description.
help.questions: If the description lacks something important, the AI will ask you 2 to 4 questions before specifying.
help.privacy: Do not paste code, credentials or confidential data: the text is sent to an external AI provider.

progress.title: Generating the specification
progress.description: It usually takes 10 to 30 seconds. You can leave this page: the generation goes on and you will find it in the project history.

clarification.title: The AI needs a few details
clarification.description: Answer what you know. Any question you leave blank will be treated as an assumption in the specification.

failed.title: The specification could not be generated

notFound.title: We could not find this generation
notFound.description: It may have been deleted or the address may be wrong.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: What the AI decided without you saying so. Review it before implementing.

complexity.XL: More than a week: better split it

editor.title: Edit specification
editor.intro: Changes are validated with the same schema as the AI answer. The original version is kept.
editor.invalid: Check the highlighted fields before saving.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: You have unsaved changes in the specification. If you leave now, they will be lost.
